numericContract: Explicit binary32 stores/products for selected classic expressions; binary64 unsuffixed FRAMETIME evaluation; exact bounded integer RR milliseconds. Native compiler excess-precision behavior is not measured.

nativeEngineExecution.reason: No original Q2 engine or DLL executable was invoked. These are independent source-derived TypeScript evaluations.

limits: The checks compare a bounded independent equation/control-flow transcription to reviewed literal expectations and pinned original source. They do not prove a complete TS port or original binary equivalent.
Save cases project FIELD_AUTO declarations from original source. They do not run a save codec, reference relocation, file I/O lifecycle, or fresh-process restore.
Pickup feedback is represented by an ordered semantic marker; individual image/sound network bytes are not captured.
Frame actor mutations are authored test actions. Allocator reuse, arbitrary nested damage, physics, and mixed-family scheduling require further cases.

Native command predicates establish classic upmove and rerelease button meanings only. LegacyKEX conversion magnitudes, both-buttons precedence, 4038 wire encoding, and LMCTF prediction agreement remain project adapter obligations without independent original authority here.
Q64 cases cover the original configuration block and input predicates, not movement trajectories or server/client runtime agreement.
Retail assets, render/audio outputs, network packets, performance, and gameplay sessions were not exercised.

cases.contract: Classic stores frame*double(0.1) in binary32 seconds; rerelease accumulates the supplied integer millisecond frame time. The documented 40 Hz setting supplies 25 ms.
preconditions: Normal frame path, level starts at zero; binary32 storage with binary64 evaluation of the unsuffixed classic literal; no claim about x87 excess precision; wire codec is outside this clock.

cases.contract: A nextthink less than level.time+0.001 fires early; it is zero inside the callback, callback rescheduling survives, and SV_RunThink returns false.
preconditions: Valid synchronous think callback; values use seconds.

cases.contract: A deadline beyond the classic epsilon remains pending and returns true.
preconditions: Values use seconds.

cases.contract: A zero deadline disables think even after level time has advanced.
preconditions: Values use seconds.

cases.contract: Rerelease does not apply the classic 1 ms lookahead.
preconditions: Values use integer milliseconds.

cases.contract: An equal rerelease deadline runs synchronously, clears nextthink first, preserves rescheduling, and returns false.
preconditions: Valid synchronous think callback; integer milliseconds.

cases.contract: The world runs first, the client takes ClientBeginServerFrame, later edicts run in slot order, then rules and final client frames run.
preconditions: No intermission, ground changes, or entity callback mutations. Slots 0,1,2,3 in use; maxclients=1; entity callback order is recorded, not complete physics.

cases.contract: The loop reads current num_edicts and inuse each iteration: an authored append is visible in the same frame and a deleted later slot is skipped.
preconditions: No intermission or ground changes; maxclients=1. Callback at slot 2 explicitly clears slot 3 inuse, appends active slot 4, and sets num_edicts=5. This fixture does not model G_Spawn allocator policy.

cases.contract: False pickup return suppresses feedback/freeing, but targets fire before the failed-pickup early return and before ITEM_TARGETS_USED is set.
preconditions: Alive client; ordinary supported ammo; positive quantity; no weapon flag; singleplayer; no stay-coop or respawn flags; target callback observes without deleting the item.

cases.contract: ITEM_TARGETS_USED suppresses a repeat target callback when the pickup still fails.
preconditions: Alive client; ordinary supported ammo; positive quantity; no weapon flag; singleplayer; no stay-coop or respawn flags; target callback observes without deleting the item.

cases.contract: Clamped partial pickup returns true; targets synchronously observe the updated inventory before the item is freed.
preconditions: Alive client; ordinary supported ammo; positive quantity; no weapon flag; singleplayer; no stay-coop or respawn flags; target callback observes without deleting the item.

cases.contract: Armor saves ceil(binary32(protection*damage)), so jacket armor absorbs one normal damage entirely.
preconditions: Client with selected armor, positive damage entering CheckArmor; no preceding damage modifiers modeled.

cases.contract: The binary32 product of stored 0.3f and 10 is 3, so ceil saves 3. Promoting stored 0.3f directly to binary64 multiplication would incorrectly save 4 in this model.
preconditions: Binary32 multiplication without x87 excess precision; client with jacket armor; normal damage.

cases.contract: Jacket energy protection is zero and emits no armor spark event.
preconditions: Client with jacket armor; no preceding damage modifiers modeled.

cases.contract: Absorption cannot exceed remaining armor inventory.
preconditions: Client with body armor; no preceding damage modifiers modeled.

cases.contract: DAMAGE_NO_ARMOR returns zero before inventory mutation or effects.
preconditions: Client with body armor; no preceding damage modifiers modeled.

cases.contract: A trigger ORs its bits into unit flags; the target requires every requested non-editor bit before using targets and freeing itself.
preconditions: Non-deathmatch target think invoked; synchronous G_UseTargets callback returns without mutation.

cases.contract: One missing required bit prevents progression.
preconditions: Non-deathmatch target think invoked.

cases.contract: The uint32 comparison supports high trigger bits without signed JavaScript comparison loss.
preconditions: Non-deathmatch target think invoked.

cases.contract: The cross-trigger mask excludes bits 8 through 15, including an authored required editor bit.
preconditions: Direct target-think input; spawn parsing/inhibition is outside this malformed-requirement boundary case.

cases.contract: Original FIELD_AUTO declarations retain these POI, health bar, and story fields. This is a field-selection projection, not a save codec round trip.
preconditions: Entity references are represented symbolically; JSON encoding, pointer remapping, and load hooks are not evaluated.

cases.contract: The source declares entity fog and all sampled brush animation fields, including enabled and next_tick.
preconditions: Field selection only; supplied density is the binary32 value of authored 0.35; next_tick is represented in integer milliseconds.

cases.contract: Rerelease saves the max_ammo array, whose index 8 stores flechette capacity. A TS-only max_flechettes field name is not the original representation.
preconditions: Field-selection projection; valid int16 capacities in original enum order; no byte codec claimed.

cases.contract: Game-level serialization has separate cross-level and cross-unit flag fields.
preconditions: Field selection only.

cases.contract: Extract the original ammo enum index and initialized flechette capacity directly from raw source.
preconditions: The !taken_loadout initialization branch is selected; capacity upgrades and custom loadouts are outside this case.

cases.contract: Q64 non-deathmatch worldspawn publishes CONFIG_N64_PHYSICS and immediately sets server pm_config, then publishes and stores air acceleration.
preconditions: Start at the displayed worldspawn block with integer cvar air acceleration; this does not run prediction.

cases.contract: Q64 deathmatch skips the N64 physics enable block; air acceleration still propagates.
preconditions: Initial server n64_physics=false; surrounding worldspawn reset and cgame update callbacks are outside this block.

cases.contract: This source block contains no else clearing n64_physics; prior state is retained when its condition is false.
preconditions: Deliberately supplied pre-block true state; this does not imply that full worldspawn fails to reset configuration.

cases.contract: upmove=9 does not hold classic jump; the rerelease jump button does hold rerelease jump.
preconditions: Only command predicates are evaluated. Alive grounded client; landing timer and jump-held clear; no ladder; standing transition trace clear. Full movement is outside this case.

cases.contract: upmove=10 holds classic jump independently of rerelease button bits.
preconditions: Only command predicates are evaluated. Alive grounded client; landing timer and jump-held clear; no ladder; standing transition trace clear. Full movement is outside this case.

cases.contract: Negative classic upmove and rerelease BUTTON_CROUCH request their grounded duck branches.
preconditions: Only command predicates are evaluated. Alive grounded client; landing timer and jump-held clear; no ladder; standing transition trace clear. Full movement is outside this case.

cases.contract: Q64 configuration prevents the rerelease duck branch even with BUTTON_CROUCH set.
preconditions: Only command predicates are evaluated. Alive grounded client; landing timer and jump-held clear; no ladder; standing transition trace clear. Full movement is outside this case.
